full.en: Bio Baobab (Adansonia Digitata) Powder. Ingredients: 100 % Organic Baobab pulp powder. Usage instructions: Recommended daily dose is 2-5 g (1 teaspoon). Mix in fruit or vegetable juices. Storage: cool and dry place.
